author: minertedtoad
body:
IGN:
Discord( Name#): @OfficialMinertedtoad#8335 
Timezone: GMT
Any previous Ref experience? No 

Why would you like to join the referee team: I would like to be apart of the team because I would like to help out the community and people who need help. Also I have been encouraged by friends to apply again and go for what I want to do. Also I know a lot of people who are refs and I will definitely get on with them as a team. 

Are you able to commit to Saturday Tournaments, and occasionally event staff meetings? I am able to commit as log as they're after around 5pm or I have nothing else planned. I most likely will be able to come to staff meetings as I can work around my schedule to get to them.

A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself: I applied for ref last time the apps were open and have been encouraged by friends to do again. I am very good at listening to peoples opinions and also am able to memorise stuff that I need to. I know the rules like the back of my hand so I will have no problem with picking out rule breakers! 

Anything else?: I really want to get this position because being apart of the officials team will be a nice experience to have but also will be a real privilege.
